thread_usage.scope: Cumulative local runtime counters for each distinct thread; descendants discovered recursively
limitations: Samples exclude counters not yet flushed and work after each cutoff, including the current final reply.
Counters are local runtime telemetry, not a billing statement. Internal JSONL format may change.
Input includes cached input; output includes reasoning. Do not add those subsets again.
A task may span many model calls. These are full-context processing counters, not just user message lengths.
Per-thread totals must not be imported into multiple stage records. Use aligned baseline/end samples for stage attribution.
